LVT_R003.terrain: Preparefor upcoming trekking program to Langtang Tamang heritage trekking
LVT_R003.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.
Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.

LVT_R003.terrain: Today we will march to Gatlang after having breakfast. We will climb until we reach to summit of Deurali. It takes us about 5 hours. From Deurali, the path will be easy and have a flat surface. On our way, we will be served by the beautiful Langtang mountain ranges. The night will be interesting at Gatlang which is the big Tamang village.
LVT_R003.description: Traverse terraced hillsides and chortens to the traditional Tamang cultural settlement of Gatlang (2,238m) near holy Parbati Kunda.

LVT_R003.terrain: We can see that the settlement of the Tamang people of Gatlang village is bigger than other Tamang villages in that region. From Gatlang, we will descend towards the terraced farming area. We will follow the trail of pine and bamboo forest. We will continue to rise from the Thambuchet and Gang- Gong to reach to Tatopani. Our trek of today will be for about 6 to 7 hours.
LVT_R003.description: Trek stage to Tatopani (2600 m). We can see that the settlement of the Tamang people of Gatlang village is bigger than other Tamang villages in that region. From Gatlang, we will descend towards the terraced farming area. We will follow the trail of pine and bamboo forest. We will continue to rise from the Thambuchet and Gang- Gong to reach to Tatopani. Our trek of today will be for about 6 to 7 hours.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

LVT_R003.terrain: At Tatopani, we will wake up early and bath at natural hot water. After bathing we will have breakfast. Then continue our journey toward Thuman. We will follow the way of rhododendron and oak forest viewing some mountain ranges to Nagthali Danda. Then we will descend towards the Thuman. While descending we will return through the dense forest of rhododendron.
LVT_R003.description: Trek through rhododendron groves to Thuman (2,338m), an authentic Tamang village renowned for traditional Shamanic culture and peak views.

LVT_R003.terrain: Our trekking route from Thuman to Briddim is about 6 to 7 hours long. Our trial goes ups and downs from the beginning. We will have the opportunity to interact with the local Tamang people. From the exploration, we will be familiar with the tradition of Tibetan people following the Buddhism religion. From Pelko, the way goes much easier to Briddim.
LVT_R003.description: Scenic descent into the Tibetan-influenced village of Briddim (2,229m), celebrated for its community rotational homestays and cultural warmth.

LVT_R003.terrain: We will return back to Lama Hotel and the route goes through the dense forest of pine. After walking for about 1 hour, we will be at Khamjing village. Our trial goes through the land of cultivating potatoes, barley, and wheat. We will see Lauribinayak pass onwards to Gosainkunda with the Langtang Lirung. The trail will pass through the Sherpa Gaun, Rimche, and finally to the lama hotel. The night will be at the lama hotel.
LVT_R003.description: Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).

LVT_R003.terrain: Early morning we will continue our journey towards the Langtang village. We can get glimpses of Langtang Mountain from the viewpoint. By spending some valuable time in Langtang village we can see the cultivated areas of buckwheat, potatoes, wheat, barley, etc. by enclosing them inside a stoned wall area.
LVT_R003.description: Climb gradually through widening river gorges past Ghodatabela checkpost (3,030m). Reach the resilient alpine settlement of Langtang Village (3,430m) beneath Langtang Lirung.

LVT_R003.terrain: Today our trek will take us to Kyangjin. Our trial from Langtang gradually climbs up to the small villages and yak pasture land to Kyangjin. There we can see a government-operated cheese factory here. After reaching Kyangjin at the altitude of 3800m, we will spend our leisure by exploring Kyangjin Gompa.
LVT_R003.description: Short scenic ascent across yak pastures and Mani stone walls to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m). Explore the ancient monastery, local yak cheese factory, and majestic 360-degree amphitheater.

LVT_R003.terrain: We will trek further down to lama hotel. We will view the same thing that we have seen while going up but from different prospects. Hence our trek goes downward to Ghodatabela, we will have our lunch there. After having lunch, we will continue to lama hotel for the rest of the night.
LVT_R003.description: Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).

LVT_R003.terrain: After having the breakfast at lama hotel, we will walk back to Syabrubesi in a very energetic way. Our trekking route goes through the glorious forested area with beautiful flowers and smells coming from them. We will continue our way until we reach Syabrubesi at an altitude of 2000m from lama hotel.
LVT_R003.description: Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.

LVT_R003.terrain: After having breakfast at Syabrubesi, a drive of 6 to 7 hours will be enough to return to Kathmandu. We will definitely enjoy the view of the green forest and the roadside houses while returning to Kathmandu. The evening will be delightful visiting the market area of Kathmandu. We will take a rest at night at the hotel arranged by Nepal Everest Base Camp Trek.
LVT_R003.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

MKBC_IT001.description: Trek stage to Chichila (1980 m). Drive to Pokhara. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Scenic mountain drive from Tumlingtar through Khandbari and Chichila to the high ridge settlement of Num (1,560m), overlooking the deep Arun gorge.
Descend steeply to the Arun River suspension bridge and climb the opposite mountainside past cardamom terraces to Seduwa (1,500m), the national park entry gate.
Trek along terraced ridges through beautiful Rai and Sherpa villages to Tashigaon (2,100m), the last permanent human settlement on the Makalu trail.
Steep ascent of over 1,400m through ancient rhododendron and mossy cloud forests to reach the scenic high ridge camp at Khongma (3,500m).

MKBC_IT001.description: Trek stage to Dobate (3650 m). Gurung village. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Cross Shipton La Pass (4,216m) and descend into the wild Barun River gorge, arriving at the peaceful alpine meadow of Yangle Kharka (3,557m) framed by sheer granite cliffs.
Hike along the turquoise Barun river through alpine scrub and glacial moraines to Langmale Kharka (4,410m), enjoying close-up vistas of Peak 7.
Trek along the lateral moraine of the Barun Glacier to Makalu Base Camp (4,870m), surrounded by the immense south face of Makalu and Everest's Kangshung face.

TRL-IT001.terrain: Explore city and visit Bhimsen mandir dolkha
TRL-IT001.description: Drive along the Araniko and BP highways to Charikot (1,955m), the scenic district capital of Dolakha, enjoying panoramic vistas of Gauri Shankar.

TRL-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
TRL-IT001.description: Winding descent down the mountain highway along the Tamakoshi River to Singati Bazaar (950m), a bustling local trading center.

TRL-IT001.terrain: On the way, you will come across beautiful landscapes and waterfalls which will welcome you on the way.
TRL-IT001.description: Jeep drive along the rugged river road to Chetchet (1,398m), crossing the long suspension bridge that marks the official trailhead for Rolwaling.

TRL-IT001.terrain: Once at Chetchet, start your trek to Simi Gaun. Cross a beautiful suspension bridge and climb steep stairs and a well-maintained trail. According to the season, you will see crops on the farmlands. Distance from Chectchet to Simi Gaun is just 2.5 KM which you can cover around 2-3 hours.
TRL-IT001.description: Steep stone staircase ascent of over 600 vertical meters through terraced fields to Simigaun (2,000m), a picturesque Buddhist and Hindu village perched high on the ridge.
Trek stage to Surmuche (2470 m). Beautiful views. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Trek stage to Kyalche (2810 m). Sunrise view. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

TRL-IT001.terrain: Dongang is a beautiful place beside a gurgling Rolwaling river and a peaceful lush green forest. It is a popular stop for travelers, trekkers, and porters as this place provides an amazing vibe and a great place to rest.
TRL-IT001.description: Trek stage to Dongang (2800 m). Dongang is a beautiful place beside a gurgling Rolwaling river and a peaceful lush green forest. It is a popular stop for travelers, trekkers, and porters as this place provides an amazing vibe and a great place to rest.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Trek stage to Thanding (3343 m). Gurung village. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

TRL-IT001.terrain: The trail is full of mind-blowing landscapes, peaceful trails, a few challenging stairs, and mesmerizing waterfalls. On the way, you will cross a few bridges over a powerful river marking its territory. Landscape slowly changes with fewer trees and more open pasture land with giant hills surrounding. Cross a huge suspension bridge right before entering the Beding area, which is a unique experience to get.
TRL-IT001.description: Climb through dense forests into the glacial Rolwaling valley, passing Kyalche and Dongang to arrive at Beding (3,690m), the historic cultural hub of the valley.

TRL-IT001.terrain: Na Village is one of the most beautiful village as the landscape is very unique with well-maintained trails and traditional houses along the beautiful pastureland. The path leading to the village is very peaceful. Along the way, you will be accompanied by small waterfalls and seasonal vegetation that includes vibrant flowers. Once you reach the settlement you will also get to see domesticated animals such as yaks and highland cattle grazing from a distance.
TRL-IT001.description: Gentle acclimatization walk past Mani walls and alpine yak pastures, arriving at Na Village (4,180m), the highest permanent summer settlement in Rolwaling.

TRL-IT001.terrain: Tsho Rolpa Lake, one of the most beautiful lakes enclosed by giant mountains and mesmerizing views. Visit Dudh Kunda, which is around 4 km far from Tsho Rolpa Lake. NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_IT001.description: The route becomes increasingly alpine as it climbs toward Panipakha. Forest gradually changes as elevation increases. Panipakha is an important camping location on the circuit.

NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_IT001.description: Trek stage to Panipakha (3105 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_IT001.description: The trail climbs through rhododendron and alpine vegetation toward the summer pasture of Maanedanda. This is an important acclimatization stage because the elevation approaches 4,000 m.

NCC_IT001.terrain: Accommodation: Camping
NCC_IT001.description: This is one of the most scenic days of the trek. The route climbs from Maanedanda toward Jatapokhari and then continues to Panch Pokhari, a sacred high-altitude lake group. NCC_IT001.terrain: Accommodation: Camping

NCC_IT001.terrain: Accommodation: Camping/basic shelter

NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

NCC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

ABC-R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.
Travel along the Prithvi Highway to Pokhara (822m) or take a 25-minute scenic flight. Relax by Phewa Lake with views of Fishtail (Machhapuchhre) and prep for the trailhead.
Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul and trek through Birethanti, climbing the famous stone staircase of 3,200 steps to the hilltop Magar village of Ulleri (1,960m).
Pleasant uphill walk through dense ancient rhododendron and oak moss forests, listening to mountain streams to arrive at the high ridge village of Ghorepani (2,860m).
Early morning hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) for sunrise over the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges, followed by a ridgeline descent through deep forest to Tadapani (2,630m).
Descend to Kimrong Khola and ascend stone pathways to Chhomrong (2,170m), the dramatic terraced Gurung village directly facing Fishtail and Annapurna South.
Drop through bamboo thickets into the narrow Modi Khola gorge, ascending steadily past weeping waterfalls to reach Himalaya Hotel (2,920m).

hotels.package: NPR 2,000 [Include room, Dinner, Breakfast, Device charging, Hot shower, Wi-Fi]

ABC-R001.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.
Celebrate dawn over the Annapurna amphitheater, then descend rapidly down the Modi Khola valley through Deurali and Dovan to rest at Bamboo (2,310m).
Trail climbs to Chhomrong then drops down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m), famous for natural hot spring pools beside the roaring Modi Khola.
Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

AC_R003.stage_title: Meta → Junam Goth → Chyakhu Khola → Kyang → Phu Gate → Phu Gaon
AC_R003.terrain: The valley opens into a high-altitude desert landscape. Ancient chortens, mani walls, and abandoned kharkas appear along the route.
AC_R003.description: The valley opens into a high-altitude desert landscape. Ancient chortens, mani walls, and abandoned kharkas appear along the route.

AC_R003.stage_title: Phu → Tashi Lhakhang Monastery → viewpoint above the village
AC_R003.terrain: You are now above 4,000 m, so acclimatization significantly reduces the risk of AMS before crossing Kang La.
AC_R003.description: Trek stage to Phu Gaon (4080 m). You are now above 4,000 m, so acclimatization significantly reduces the risk of AMS before crossing Kang La.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC_R003.stage_title: Phu → Kyang → Mahendra Pul → Nar Phedi
AC_R003.terrain: Nar Phedi Monastery is a unique accommodation experience where trekkers often stay beside Buddhist monks.
AC_R003.description: Trek stage to Nar Phedi (3490 m). Nar Phedi Monastery is a unique accommodation experience where trekkers often stay beside Buddhist monks.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC_R003.stage_title: Tilicho Base Camp to Shree Kharka (via Tilicho Lake)
AC_R003.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC_R003.description: Trek stage to Nar Village (4110 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

AC_R003.terrain: This is the key acclimatization day before the 5,300+ m Kang La Pass
AC_R003.description: Trek stage to Nar Village (4110 m). This is the key acclimatization day before the 5,300+ m Kang La Pass. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC_R003.stage_title: Nar → Jhombu Kharka → Kang La Pass → Kang La Phedi → Ngawal
AC_R003.terrain: Start before dawn Gradual climb across yak pastures Final steep switchbacks to the pass
AC_R003.description: The hardest day of the Nar Phu section. A long descent on scree and alpine trails eventually joins the main Annapurna Circuit at Ngawal.

AC_R003.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC_R003.description: Trek stage to Manang (3540 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

AC_R003.terrain: Best Acclimatization Options Hike Altitude Time Gangapurna Lake 3,900 m 2–3 hr Ice Lake 4,600 m 5–6 hr Chongkor Viewpoint 4,200 m 3–4 hr
AC_R003.description: Trek stage to Manang (3540 m). Best Acclimatization Options Hike Altitude Time Gangapurna Lake 3,900 m 2–3 hr Ice Lake 4,600 m 5–6 hr Chongkor Viewpoint 4,200 m 3–4 hr. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC_R003.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC_R003.description: Acclimatization stage climbing past ancient juniper groves and yak pastures to Yak Kharka (4,050m), resting beneath towering rock faces.

AC_R003.terrain: Hydrate aggressively Eat well Sleep early Most trekkers start at 3:00–4:00 AM the next day
AC_R003.description: Ascend the desolate lunar landscape above the treeline to Thorong Phedi (4,540m), the crucial high-altitude staging point before crossing the legendary Thorong La Pass.

AC_R003.stage_title: Thorong Phedi → High Camp → Thorong La Pass → Chabarbu → Muktinath
AC_R003.terrain: 900 m ascent in cold pre-dawn conditions Slow, steady pace is essential
AC_R003.description: The classic Annapurna Circuit high-pass day. A long 1,600 m descent leads to the sacred pilgrimage site of Muktinath.

SPL-IT001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

Settle in and relax after your journey. Take a leisurely evening stroll through the bustling streets of Thamel, soaking in the vibrant atmosphere. Enjoy a traditional Nepali welcome dinner at a local restaurant, sampling authentic dishes.

SPL-IT001.stage_title: Nepalgunj to Juphal (Flight) – Trek to Dunai
SPL-IT001.description: Arrive in Dunai (2,140m), the administrative headquarters of Dolpa district set along the banks of the Thuli Bheri river.
Follow the Suligad river into Shey Phoksundo National Park, walking through bamboo and pine woods to the forested hamlet of Chhepka (2,670m).

SPL-IT001.stage_title: Walk from Chhepka to Jharana Hotel.
SPL-IT001.description: Trek stage to Jharana hotel (3370 m). Sunrise view. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

SPL-IT001.stage_title: Jharana Hotel to Shey Phoksundo Lake (Ringmo Village)
SPL-IT001.description: Climb through cedar forests past Nepal's highest waterfall (Suligad, 167m) to Ringmo (3,611m), an ancient Bon village on the shores of turquoise Lake Phoksundo.

SPL-IT001.stage_title: Rest Day at Shey Phoksundo Lake
SPL-IT001.description: Climb through cedar forests past Nepal's highest waterfall (Suligad, 167m) to Ringmo (3,611m), an ancient Bon village on the shores of turquoise Lake Phoksundo.

ABC_IT002.stage_title: Drive from Pokhara to Ghandruk & Trek from Ghandruk to Chhomrong
ABC_IT002.description: Descend to Kimrong Khola and ascend stone pathways to Chhomrong (2,170m), the dramatic terraced Gurung village directly facing Fishtail and Annapurna South.
Celebrate dawn over the Annapurna amphitheater, then descend rapidly down the Modi Khola valley through Deurali and Dovan to rest at Bamboo (2,310m).

ABC_IT002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
ABC_IT002.description: Climb past Hinku Cave along steep rock walls where avalanches often run, keeping a steady pace to reach the narrow valley bottleneck at Deurali (3,230m).

ABC_IT002.stage_title: Trek from Deurali to Annapurna Base Camp
ABC_IT002.terrain: ⚠️ Altitude Note: Take it slow and stay hydrated.
ABC_IT002.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.

ABC_IT002.stage_title: Sunrise at Annapurna Base Camp & Trek Down to Bamboo
ABC_IT002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
ABC_IT002.description: Celebrate dawn over the Annapurna amphitheater, then descend rapidly down the Modi Khola valley through Deurali and Dovan to rest at Bamboo (2,310m).
Trail climbs to Chhomrong then drops down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m), famous for natural hot spring pools beside the roaring Modi Khola.
Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.
Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

Drop through bamboo thickets into the narrow Modi Khola gorge, ascending steadily past weeping waterfalls to reach Himalaya Hotel (2,920m).

TRL-R001.description: Jeep drive along the rugged river road to Chetchet (1,398m), crossing the long suspension bridge that marks the official trailhead for Rolwaling.

TRL-R001.terrain: Once at Chetchet, start your trek to Simi Gaun. Cross a beautiful suspension bridge and climb steep stairs and a well-maintained trail. According to the season, you will see crops on the farmlands. Distance from Chectchet to Simi Gaun is just 2.5 KM which you can cover around 2-3 hours.
TRL-R001.description: Steep stone staircase ascent of over 600 vertical meters through terraced fields to Simigaun (2,000m), a picturesque Buddhist and Hindu village perched high on the ridge.
Trek stage to Surmuche (2470 m). Beautiful views. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Trek stage to Kyalche (2810 m). Sunrise view. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

TRL-R001.terrain: Dongang is a beautiful place beside a gurgling Rolwaling river and a peaceful lush green forest. It is a popular stop for travelers, trekkers, and porters as this place provides an amazing vibe and a great place to rest.
TRL-R001.description: Trek stage to Dongang (2800 m). Dongang is a beautiful place beside a gurgling Rolwaling river and a peaceful lush green forest. It is a popular stop for travelers, trekkers, and porters as this place provides an amazing vibe and a great place to rest.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Trek stage to Thanding (3343 m). Gurung village. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

TRL-R001.terrain: The trail is full of mind-blowing landscapes, peaceful trails, a few challenging stairs, and mesmerizing waterfalls. On the way, you will cross a few bridges over a powerful river marking its territory. Landscape slowly changes with fewer trees and more open pasture land with giant hills surrounding. Cross a huge suspension bridge right before entering the Beding area, which is a unique experience to get.
TRL-R001.description: Climb through dense forests into the glacial Rolwaling valley, passing Kyalche and Dongang to arrive at Beding (3,690m), the historic cultural hub of the valley.

TRL-R001.terrain: Na Village is one of the most beautiful village as the landscape is very unique with well-maintained trails and traditional houses along the beautiful pastureland. The path leading to the village is very peaceful. Along the way, you will be accompanied by small waterfalls and seasonal vegetation that includes vibrant flowers. Once you reach the settlement you will also get to see domesticated animals such as yaks and highland cattle grazing from a distance.
TRL-R001.description: Gentle acclimatization walk past Mani walls and alpine yak pastures, arriving at Na Village (4,180m), the highest permanent summer settlement in Rolwaling.

TRL-R001.terrain: Tsho Rolpa Lake, one of the most beautiful lakes enclosed by giant mountains and mesmerizing views. Visit Dudh Kunda, which is around 4 km far from Tsho Rolpa Lake. The trek to Dudh Kunda is optional which is a small lake above Tsho Rolpa Lake. Soak in the beauty of the lakes and explore the surroundings.
TRL-R001.description: Hike along the glacial moraine to Tsho-Rolpa Glacial Lake (4,580m), Nepal's largest turquoise glacial lake, framed by sheer ice walls and towering peaks.

ABC-IT007.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.

ABC-IT007.description: Climb past Hinku Cave along steep rock walls where avalanches often run, keeping a steady pace to reach the narrow valley bottleneck at Deurali (3,230m).
Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.
Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.
Trail climbs to Chhomrong then drops down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m), famous for natural hot spring pools beside the roaring Modi Khola.
Celebrate dawn over the Annapurna amphitheater, then descend rapidly down the Modi Khola valley through Deurali and Dovan to rest at Bamboo (2,310m).
Trek stage to Nayapul (1070 m). Back to Pokhara. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

MBC_R001.stage_title: Explore Kathmandu and prepare for trek.
MBC_R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.
Drive from Kathmandu to Arughat and continue along the winding riverside road to Soti Khola (710m), the bustling trailhead along the rushing Budhi Gandaki river.
Follow the Budhi Gandaki gorge across suspension bridges and rocky riverbeds, passing waterfalls and terraced hillsides to reach the Gurung village of Machha Khola (900m).
Ascend alongside the roaring river gorge, crossing cantilever bridges and Tatopani natural hot springs to enter the stone-paved conservation checkpoint village of Jagat (1,340m).
Trek through bamboo groves and cross the suspension bridge into Deng (1,860m), the cultural entrance to the Tibetan-influenced Nubri region.
Ascend steeply through lush rhododendron and fir forests, climbing into the upper alpine valley to reach Namrung (2,630m), known for its scenic apple orchards and stone gates.
Pass Mani walls and alpine pastures to enter Samagaon (3,530m), the largest Buddhist settlement in the Nubri valley beneath Mount Manaslu, with acclimatization trails to Birendra Tal.

MBC_R001.stage_title: Acclimatization Day: Hike to Manaslu Base Camp
MBC_R001.description: Pass Mani walls and alpine pastures to enter Samagaon (3,530m), the largest Buddhist settlement in the Nubri valley beneath Mount Manaslu, with acclimatization trails to Birendra Tal.
Gradual scenic trek along the upper Budhi Gandaki yak pastures, approaching the historic Tibetan trading border settlement of Samdo (3,860m).
Climb past the abandoned market of Larkya Bazaar to Dharamsala / Larkya Phedi (4,460m), the rugged high camp refuge preparing for the Larkya La pass.
Pre-dawn crossing of Larkya La Pass (5,160m) with sweeping views of Himlung Himal and Cheo Himal, followed by a dramatic descent into the stunning glacial meadow of Bimthang (3,720m).

LVT-R003.terrain: Today we will march to Gatlang after having breakfast. We will climb until we reach to summit of Deurali. It takes us about 5 hours. From Deurali, the path will be easy and have a flat surface. On our way, we will be served by the beautiful Langtang mountain ranges. The night will be interesting at Gatlang which is the big Tamang village.
LVT-R003.description: Traverse terraced hillsides and chortens to the traditional Tamang cultural settlement of Gatlang (2,238m) near holy Parbati Kunda.

LVT-R003.terrain: We can see that the settlement of the Tamang people of Gatlang village is bigger than other Tamang villages in that region. From Gatlang, we will descend towards the terraced farming area. We will follow the trail of pine and bamboo forest. We will continue to rise from the Thambuchet and Gang- Gong to reach to Tatopani. Our trek of today will be for about 6 to 7 hours.
LVT-R003.description: Trek stage to Tatopani (2600 m). We can see that the settlement of the Tamang people of Gatlang village is bigger than other Tamang villages in that region. From Gatlang, we will descend towards the terraced farming area. We will follow the trail of pine and bamboo forest. We will continue to rise from the Thambuchet and Gang- Gong to reach to Tatopani. Our trek of today will be for about 6 to 7 hours.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

LVT-R003.terrain: At Tatopani, we will wake up early and bath at natural hot water. After bathing we will have breakfast. Then continue our journey toward Thuman. We will follow the way of rhododendron and oak forest viewing some mountain ranges to Nagthali Danda. Then we will descend towards the Thuman. While descending we will return through the dense forest of rhododendron.
LVT-R003.description: Trek through rhododendron groves to Thuman (2,338m), an authentic Tamang village renowned for traditional Shamanic culture and peak views.

LVT-R003.terrain: Our trekking route from Thuman to Briddim is about 6 to 7 hours long. Our trial goes ups and downs from the beginning. We will have the opportunity to interact with the local Tamang people. From the exploration, we will be familiar with the tradition of Tibetan people following the Buddhism religion. From Pelko, the way goes much easier to Briddim.
LVT-R003.description: Scenic descent into the Tibetan-influenced village of Briddim (2,229m), celebrated for its community rotational homestays and cultural warmth.

LVT-R003.terrain: We will return back to Lama Hotel and the route goes through the dense forest of pine. After walking for about 1 hour, we will be at Khamjing village. Our trial goes through the land of cultivating potatoes, barley, and wheat. We will see Lauribinayak pass onwards to Gosainkunda with the Langtang Lirung. The trail will pass through the Sherpa Gaun, Rimche, and finally to the lama hotel. The night will be at the lama hotel.
LVT-R003.description: Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).

LVT-R003.terrain: Early morning we will continue our journey towards the Langtang village. We can get glimpses of Langtang Mountain from the viewpoint. By spending some valuable time in Langtang village we can see the cultivated areas of buckwheat, potatoes, wheat, barley, etc. by enclosing them inside a stoned wall area.
LVT-R003.description: Climb gradually through widening river gorges past Ghodatabela checkpost (3,030m). Reach the resilient alpine settlement of Langtang Village (3,430m) beneath Langtang Lirung.

LVT-R003.terrain: Today our trek will take us to Kyangjin. Our trial from Langtang gradually climbs up to the small villages and yak pasture land to Kyangjin. There we can see a government-operated cheese factory here. After reaching Kyangjin at the altitude of 3800m, we will spend our leisure by exploring Kyangjin Gompa.
LVT-R003.description: Short scenic ascent across yak pastures and Mani stone walls to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m). Explore the ancient monastery, local yak cheese factory, and majestic 360-degree amphitheater.

LVT-R003.terrain: We will trek further down to lama hotel. We will view the same thing that we have seen while going up but from different prospects. Hence our trek goes downward to Ghodatabela, we will have our lunch there. After having lunch, we will continue to lama hotel for the rest of the night.
LVT-R003.description: Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).

LVT-R003.terrain: After having the breakfast at lama hotel, we will walk back to Syabrubesi in a very energetic way. Our trekking route goes through the glorious forested area with beautiful flowers and smells coming from them. We will continue our way until we reach Syabrubesi at an altitude of 2000m from lama hotel.
LVT-R003.description: Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.

LVT-R003.terrain: After having breakfast at Syabrubesi, a drive of 6 to 7 hours will be enough to return to Kathmandu. We will definitely enjoy the view of the green forest and the roadside houses while returning to Kathmandu. The evening will be delightful visiting the market area of Kathmandu. We will take a rest at night at the hotel arranged by Nepal Everest Base Camp Trek.
LVT-R003.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: The trail gradually climbs through cultivated terraces and forest. You pass small settlements before reaching Khahare.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: The route becomes increasingly alpine as it climbs toward Panipakha. Forest gradually changes as elevation increases. Panipakha is an important camping location on the circuit.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: The trail climbs through rhododendron and alpine vegetation toward the summer pasture of Maanedanda. This is an important acclimatization stage because the elevation approaches 4,000 m.

This is one of the most scenic days of the trek. The route climbs from Maanedanda toward Jatapokhari and then continues to Panch Pokhari, a sacred high-altitude lake group. Panch Pokhari is reported at approximately 4,515 m, although some sources give slightly different elevations for the lake area.
Trek stage to Tare/Thare Kharka (4880 m). Accommodation: Camping. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

NCC-R002.stage_title: Tare Kharka → Gyajo La → Dudhpokhari/Likhu area
NCC-R002.terrain: Overnight: Depending on the exact route, camp near Dudhpokhari/Likhu area or continue toward Ngeju.
NCC-R002.description: This is the most demanding section of the circuit. You climb from Tare toward Gyajo La, also referred to as Thulo Lapcha in some descriptions. At approximately 4,880 m / 16,010 ft, it is the highest point of the standard circuit.
Continue through the remote Likhu basin. The trail descends from the high glacial environment toward Ngeju Kharka.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: The trail now descends significantly toward the lower settlements. Lhachhewar is situated in a more vegetated environment compared with the barren high-altitude landscape.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: Trek stage to Gumdel (3360 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: Climb past Hinku Cave along steep rock walls where avalanches often run, keeping a steady pace to reach the narrow valley bottleneck at Deurali (3,230m).

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: This is the cheese heritage day of the trek. The route passes toward Thodung, famous for its historic yak/chauri cheese production. The first yak cheese factory associated with the circuit was established in the 1950s; sources commonly cite 1957 for the Thodung facility.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: A long descent brings you to Those, completing the main Numbur Cheese Circuit. Those is traditionally used as the end point of the circuit.

NCC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R002.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

NCC-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

NCC-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

NABC_R001.stage_title: Pokhara to Tatopani (1,190m) – 6-7 Hours by Local Jeep or Bus
NABC_R001.description: Travel on a local bus or jeep to Tatopani, known for its natural hot springs. The ride takes you through winding mountain roads, offering glimpses of rural life and cascading waterfalls. Buckle up for a thrilling off-road journey to Hum Khola, a small village surrounded by towering hills and flowing rivers.

NABC_R001.stage_title: Today’s hike is shorter but incredibly rewarding. As you approach Panchakunda, the landscapes transform into rocky outcrops and meadows dotted with wildflowers. The air feels crisp, and the towering peaks seem closer than ever. Locals believe Panchakunda is a sacred site, adding a spiritual touch to the journey. A relatively short hike takes you to the Annapurna North Base Camp, where you’ll be greeted by the awe-inspiring sight of Annapurna I (8,091m) and its neighboring peaks. The base camp feels like another world, with its glaciers, rocky terrain, and serene atmosphere. Spend time soaking in the views and capturing unforgettable moments. Overnight in a tented camp.
NABC_R001.description: The trail to Sadi Kharka takes you through dense rhododendrons and oak forests, with occasional clearings that offer stunning views of the Annapurna range. The climb is gradual, allowing you to acclimatize. The trail to Bhusket Mela becomes steeper as you climb higher into the alpine terrain.

NABC_R001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC_R001.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.

NABC_R001.stage_title: The bumpy ride back to Tatopani feels like a reunion with modern comforts. You’ll enjoy the hot springs once again, easing your tired muscles and letting the warmth sink in after days of trekking. Spend the evening relaxing and enjoying the cozy atmosphere of this small village.
NABC_R001.description: Afterward, continue trekking down to Siwai, where a private vehicle awaits to drive you back to Pokhara. This marks the end of your memorable Annapurna Base Camp trek.

NABC_R001.stage_title: Heading back to Pokhara, you’ll feel a mix of emotions—relief, accomplishment, and nostalgia. The drive offers a final chance to soak in the beauty of the hills before you arrive in Pokhara. Once back, treat yourself to a delicious meal and perhaps a stroll by the Phewa Lake.

IP_IT001.description: Follow the panoramic Dudh Koshi contour trail before a winding climb through rhododendron woods to Tengboche Monastery (3,867m), framed by Ama Dablam and Everest.

IP_IT001.terrain: Lobuche a small settlement nestled in the shadows of some of the world’s highest mountains, including Pumori and Nuptse. The crisp air combined with awe-inspiring vistas of these towering peaks.
IP_IT001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP_IT001.terrain: Take time to immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere and capture stunning photographs of this unforgettable experience. The sight of vibrant tents set against the stunning backdrop of Mount Everest will create lasting memories you'll cherish for a lifetime. Celebrate this remarkable achievement with your fellow trekkers, sharing stories and laughter that will bond you for life.

IP_IT001.description: Today's trek of 7.9 km feels more like a hop and a skip as we tackle the largely downhill hike from Khumjung to Monjo (2,835 m), also spelled Manjo, our lungs nearing bursting point with what now feels like excessively oxygenated air! The ever-greener scenery is incredibly pretty, and we spend much of the day walking along forest paths, crossing a handful of suspension bridges, and enjoying the background soundtrack of the Dudh Kosi.

MKBC-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MKBC-IT001.description: Cross Shipton La Pass (4,216m) and descend into the wild Barun River gorge, arriving at the peaceful alpine meadow of Yangle Kharka (3,557m) framed by sheer granite cliffs.

MKBC-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MKBC-IT001.description: Trek along terraced ridges through beautiful Rai and Sherpa villages to Tashigaon (2,100m), the last permanent human settlement on the Makalu trail.

MKBC-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views

LVT_IT003.terrain: Preparefor upcoming trekking program to Langtang Tamang heritage trekking
LVT_IT003.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.
Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.

LVT_IT003.terrain: Today we will march to Gatlang after having breakfast. We will climb until we reach to summit of Deurali. It takes us about 5 hours. From Deurali, the path will be easy and have a flat surface. On our way, we will be served by the beautiful Langtang mountain ranges. The night will be interesting at Gatlang which is the big Tamang village.
LVT_IT003.description: Traverse terraced hillsides and chortens to the traditional Tamang cultural settlement of Gatlang (2,238m) near holy Parbati Kunda.

LVT_IT003.terrain: We can see that the settlement of the Tamang people of Gatlang village is bigger than other Tamang villages in that region. From Gatlang, we will descend towards the terraced farming area. We will follow the trail of pine and bamboo forest. We will continue to rise from the Thambuchet and Gang- Gong to reach to Tatopani. Our trek of today will be for about 6 to 7 hours.
LVT_IT003.description: Trek stage to Tatopani (2600 m). We can see that the settlement of the Tamang people of Gatlang village is bigger than other Tamang villages in that region. From Gatlang, we will descend towards the terraced farming area. We will follow the trail of pine and bamboo forest. We will continue to rise from the Thambuchet and Gang- Gong to reach to Tatopani. Our trek of today will be for about 6 to 7 hours.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

LVT_IT003.terrain: At Tatopani, we will wake up early and bath at natural hot water. After bathing we will have breakfast. Then continue our journey toward Thuman. We will follow the way of rhododendron and oak forest viewing some mountain ranges to Nagthali Danda. Then we will descend towards the Thuman. While descending we will return through the dense forest of rhododendron.
LVT_IT003.description: Trek through rhododendron groves to Thuman (2,338m), an authentic Tamang village renowned for traditional Shamanic culture and peak views.

LVT_IT003.terrain: Our trekking route from Thuman to Briddim is about 6 to 7 hours long. Our trial goes ups and downs from the beginning. We will have the opportunity to interact with the local Tamang people. From the exploration, we will be familiar with the tradition of Tibetan people following the Buddhism religion. From Pelko, the way goes much easier to Briddim.
LVT_IT003.description: Scenic descent into the Tibetan-influenced village of Briddim (2,229m), celebrated for its community rotational homestays and cultural warmth.

LVT_IT003.terrain: We will return back to Lama Hotel and the route goes through the dense forest of pine. After walking for about 1 hour, we will be at Khamjing village. Our trial goes through the land of cultivating potatoes, barley, and wheat. We will see Lauribinayak pass onwards to Gosainkunda with the Langtang Lirung. The trail will pass through the Sherpa Gaun, Rimche, and finally to the lama hotel. The night will be at the lama hotel.
LVT_IT003.description: Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).

LVT_IT003.terrain: Early morning we will continue our journey towards the Langtang village. We can get glimpses of Langtang Mountain from the viewpoint. By spending some valuable time in Langtang village we can see the cultivated areas of buckwheat, potatoes, wheat, barley, etc. by enclosing them inside a stoned wall area.
LVT_IT003.description: Climb gradually through widening river gorges past Ghodatabela checkpost (3,030m). Reach the resilient alpine settlement of Langtang Village (3,430m) beneath Langtang Lirung.

LVT_IT003.terrain: Today our trek will take us to Kyangjin. Our trial from Langtang gradually climbs up to the small villages and yak pasture land to Kyangjin. There we can see a government-operated cheese factory here. After reaching Kyangjin at the altitude of 3800m, we will spend our leisure by exploring Kyangjin Gompa.
LVT_IT003.description: Short scenic ascent across yak pastures and Mani stone walls to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m). Explore the ancient monastery, local yak cheese factory, and majestic 360-degree amphitheater.

LVT_IT003.terrain: We will trek further down to lama hotel. We will view the same thing that we have seen while going up but from different prospects. Hence our trek goes downward to Ghodatabela, we will have our lunch there. After having lunch, we will continue to lama hotel for the rest of the night.
LVT_IT003.description: Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).

LVT_IT003.terrain: After having the breakfast at lama hotel, we will walk back to Syabrubesi in a very energetic way. Our trekking route goes through the glorious forested area with beautiful flowers and smells coming from them. We will continue our way until we reach Syabrubesi at an altitude of 2000m from lama hotel.
LVT_IT003.description: Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.

LVT_IT003.terrain: After having breakfast at Syabrubesi, a drive of 6 to 7 hours will be enough to return to Kathmandu. We will definitely enjoy the view of the green forest and the roadside houses while returning to Kathmandu. The evening will be delightful visiting the market area of Kathmandu. We will take a rest at night at the hotel arranged by Nepal Everest Base Camp Trek.
LVT_IT003.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

MBC-R0023.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

MBC-R0023.terrain: Overnight stay at Machha Khola to prepare for trekking
MBC-R0023.description: Follow the Budhi Gandaki gorge across suspension bridges and rocky riverbeds, passing waterfalls and terraced hillsides to reach the Gurung village of Machha Khola (900m).

MBC-R0023.terrain: Jagat is the first major checkpoint entering Manaslu Conservation Area
MBC-R0023.description: Ascend alongside the roaring river gorge, crossing cantilever bridges and Tatopani natural hot springs to enter the stone-paved conservation checkpoint village of Jagat (1,340m).

MBC-R0023.terrain: Reaching Deng feels rewarding after a full day of mountain walking.
MBC-R0023.description: Trek through bamboo groves and cross the suspension bridge into Deng (1,860m), the cultural entrance to the Tibetan-influenced Nubri region.

MBC-R0023.terrain: Namrung offers real taste of high Himalayan scenery
MBC-R0023.description: Ascend steeply through lush rhododendron and fir forests, climbing into the upper alpine valley to reach Namrung (2,630m), known for its scenic apple orchards and stone gates.
Pass Mani walls and alpine pastures to enter Samagaon (3,530m), the largest Buddhist settlement in the Nubri valley beneath Mount Manaslu, with acclimatization trails to Birendra Tal.

MBC-R0023.stage_title: Acclimatization Day: Hike to Manaslu Base Camp
MBC-R0023.description: Pass Mani walls and alpine pastures to enter Samagaon (3,530m), the largest Buddhist settlement in the Nubri valley beneath Mount Manaslu, with acclimatization trails to Birendra Tal.
Gradual scenic trek along the upper Budhi Gandaki yak pastures, approaching the historic Tibetan trading border settlement of Samdo (3,860m).
Climb past the abandoned market of Larkya Bazaar to Dharamsala / Larkya Phedi (4,460m), the rugged high camp refuge preparing for the Larkya La pass.
Pre-dawn crossing of Larkya La Pass (5,160m) with sweeping views of Himlung Himal and Cheo Himal, followed by a dramatic descent into the stunning glacial meadow of Bimthang (3,720m).

MBC-R0023.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R0023.description: Descend through pine and rhododendron forests past Tilije to Dharapani (1,860m), where the Manaslu trail joins the Annapurna Circuit.

MBC-R0023.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R0023.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

IP_R001.terrain: Discover vibrant local markets, indulge in traditional Nepali dishes and delve into Kathmandu's rich cultural tapestry. This initial day is perfect for easing into your journey, setting the stage for the exciting adventures ahead in Khumbu region.
IP_R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

IP_R001.stage_title: Fly from KTM to Lukla and trek to Phakding, enjoying breathtaking mountain views
IP_R001.terrain: Embark on your trek to Phakding, traversing the scenic route through Nurning Ghat (2,590 m).
IP_R001.description: Arrive at Lukla airstrip and begin trekking north along the Dudh Koshi river past carved Mani stones to Phakding (2,610m).

IP_R001.stage_title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar as the gateway to the Everest region
IP_R001.description: Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

hotels.package: Social gathering spot with scenic surroundings

IP_R001.terrain: Tengboche Monastery, the spiritual heart of the Khumbu region, explore the monastery, soak in the peaceful surroundings and admire the intricate architecture and spiritual significance of this sacred place. As one of the most important monasteries in the region,.
IP_R001.description: Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

IP_R001.terrain: Dingboche known as the "summer valley," is a popular stop for trekkers heading to Everest Base Camp due to its stunning location and ample facilities. Vast open fields with majestic backdrop of Ama Dablam.
IP_R001.description: Follow the panoramic Dudh Koshi contour trail before a winding climb through rhododendron woods to Tengboche Monastery (3,867m), framed by Ama Dablam and Everest.

IP_R001.stage_title: Trek from Tengboche to Chhukung amidst breathtaking mountain scenery
IP_R001.terrain: Lobuche a small settlement nestled in the shadows of some of the world’s highest mountains, including Pumori and Nuptse. The crisp air combined with awe-inspiring vistas of these towering peaks.
IP_R001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP_R001.terrain: Take time to immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere and capture stunning photographs of this unforgettable experience. The sight of vibrant tents set against the stunning backdrop of Mount Everest will create lasting memories you'll cherish for a lifetime. Celebrate this remarkable achievement with your fellow trekkers, sharing stories and laughter that will bond you for life.
IP_R001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP_R001.stage_title: Trek from Chhukung to Island Peak Base Camp
IP_R001.terrain: Stunning display of colors as the sun rises over the towering peaks, including the magnificent Mount Everest. Breathtaking photographs and personal reflection amid the natural beauty of the world's highest mountains.
IP_R001.description: Trek along the lateral moraine of the Barun Glacier to Makalu Base Camp (4,870m), surrounded by the immense south face of Makalu and Everest's Kangshung face.

IP_R001.stage_title: Summit Island Peak and return back to Chhukung
IP_R001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP_R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
IP_R001.description: Today's trek of 7.9 km feels more like a hop and a skip as we tackle the largely downhill hike from Khumjung to Monjo (2,835 m), also spelled Manjo, our lungs nearing bursting point with what now feels like excessively oxygenated air! The ever-greener scenery is incredibly pretty, and we spend much of the day walking along forest paths, crossing a handful of suspension bridges, and enjoying the background soundtrack of the Dudh Kosi.

NABC-R001.stage_title: Pokhara to Tatopani (1,190m) – 6-7 Hours by Local Jeep or Bus
NABC-R001.description: Travel on a local bus or jeep to Tatopani, known for its natural hot springs. The ride takes you through winding mountain roads, offering glimpses of rural life and cascading waterfalls. Buckle up for a thrilling off-road journey to Hum Khola, a small village surrounded by towering hills and flowing rivers.

NABC-R001.stage_title: Today’s hike is shorter but incredibly rewarding. As you approach Panchakunda, the landscapes transform into rocky outcrops and meadows dotted with wildflowers. The air feels crisp, and the towering peaks seem closer than ever. Locals believe Panchakunda is a sacred site, adding a spiritual touch to the journey. A relatively short hike takes you to the Annapurna North Base Camp, where you’ll be greeted by the awe-inspiring sight of Annapurna I (8,091m) and its neighboring peaks. The base camp feels like another world, with its glaciers, rocky terrain, and serene atmosphere. Spend time soaking in the views and capturing unforgettable moments. Overnight in a tented camp.
NABC-R001.description: The trail to Sadi Kharka takes you through dense rhododendrons and oak forests, with occasional clearings that offer stunning views of the Annapurna range. The climb is gradual, allowing you to acclimatize. The trail to Bhusket Mela becomes steeper as you climb higher into the alpine terrain.

NABC-R001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC-R001.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.

NABC-R001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC-R001.description: Trek stage to Bhusket Mela (3850 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NABC-R001.stage_title: The bumpy ride back to Tatopani feels like a reunion with modern comforts. You’ll enjoy the hot springs once again, easing your tired muscles and letting the warmth sink in after days of trekking. Spend the evening relaxing and enjoying the cozy atmosphere of this small village.
NABC-R001.description: Afterward, continue trekking down to Siwai, where a private vehicle awaits to drive you back to Pokhara. This marks the end of your memorable Annapurna Base Camp trek.

NABC-R001.stage_title: Heading back to Pokhara, you’ll feel a mix of emotions—relief, accomplishment, and nostalgia. The drive offers a final chance to soak in the beauty of the hills before you arrive in Pokhara. Once back, treat yourself to a delicious meal and perhaps a stroll by the Phewa Lake.
NABC-R001.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.

IP-R001.terrain: Discover vibrant local markets, indulge in traditional Nepali dishes and delve into Kathmandu's rich cultural tapestry. This initial day is perfect for easing into your journey, setting the stage for the exciting adventures ahead in Khumbu region.
IP-R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

IP-R001.stage_title: Fly from KTM to Lukla and trek to Phakding, enjoying breathtaking mountain views
IP-R001.terrain: Embark on your trek to Phakding, traversing the scenic route through Nurning Ghat (2,590 m).
IP-R001.description: Arrive at Lukla airstrip and begin trekking north along the Dudh Koshi river past carved Mani stones to Phakding (2,610m).

IP-R001.stage_title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar as the gateway to the Everest region
IP-R001.description: Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

IP-R001.terrain: Dingboche known as the "summer valley," is a popular stop for trekkers heading to Everest Base Camp due to its stunning location and ample facilities. Vast open fields with majestic backdrop of Ama Dablam.
IP-R001.description: Follow the panoramic Dudh Koshi contour trail before a winding climb through rhododendron woods to Tengboche Monastery (3,867m), framed by Ama Dablam and Everest.

IP-R001.stage_title: Trek from Tengboche to Chhukung amidst breathtaking mountain scenery
IP-R001.terrain: Lobuche a small settlement nestled in the shadows of some of the world’s highest mountains, including Pumori and Nuptse. The crisp air combined with awe-inspiring vistas of these towering peaks.
IP-R001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP-R001.terrain: Take time to immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere and capture stunning photographs of this unforgettable experience. The sight of vibrant tents set against the stunning backdrop of Mount Everest will create lasting memories you'll cherish for a lifetime. Celebrate this remarkable achievement with your fellow trekkers, sharing stories and laughter that will bond you for life.
IP-R001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP-R001.stage_title: Trek from Chhukung to Island Peak Base Camp
IP-R001.terrain: Stunning display of colors as the sun rises over the towering peaks, including the magnificent Mount Everest. Breathtaking photographs and personal reflection amid the natural beauty of the world's highest mountains.
IP-R001.description: Trek along the lateral moraine of the Barun Glacier to Makalu Base Camp (4,870m), surrounded by the immense south face of Makalu and Everest's Kangshung face.

IP-R001.stage_title: Summit Island Peak and return back to Chhukung
IP-R001.description: Hike through the wide Imja Valley with dramatic close-up views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Nuptse, reaching the climbers' junction of Chhukung (4,730m).

IP-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
IP-R001.description: Today's trek of 7.9 km feels more like a hop and a skip as we tackle the largely downhill hike from Khumjung to Monjo (2,835 m), also spelled Manjo, our lungs nearing bursting point with what now feels like excessively oxygenated air! The ever-greener scenery is incredibly pretty, and we spend much of the day walking along forest paths, crossing a handful of suspension bridges, and enjoying the background soundtrack of the Dudh Kosi.

IP-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
IP-R001.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

NCC-R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: Drive from Kathmandu through Dolakha/Ramechhap toward Jiri and Shivalaya. Shivalaya is the traditional gateway to the Numbur Cheese Circuit and also lies on the historic Jiri approach toward Everest.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: The trail gradually climbs through cultivated terraces and forest. You pass small settlements before reaching Khahare.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: The route becomes increasingly alpine as it climbs toward Panipakha. Forest gradually changes as elevation increases. Panipakha is an important camping location on the circuit.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: Trek stage to Panipakha (3105 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: The trail climbs through rhododendron and alpine vegetation toward the summer pasture of Maanedanda. This is an important acclimatization stage because the elevation approaches 4,000 m.

This is one of the most scenic days of the trek. The route climbs from Maanedanda toward Jatapokhari and then continues to Panch Pokhari, a sacred high-altitude lake group. Panch Pokhari is reported at approximately 4,515 m, although some sources give slightly different elevations for the lake area.
Trek stage to Tare/Thare Kharka (4880 m). Accommodation: Camping. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Continue through the remote Likhu basin. The trail descends from the high glacial environment toward Ngeju Kharka.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: The trail now descends significantly toward the lower settlements. Lhachhewar is situated in a more vegetated environment compared with the barren high-altitude landscape.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: Trek stage to Gumdel (3360 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: Climb past Hinku Cave along steep rock walls where avalanches often run, keeping a steady pace to reach the narrow valley bottleneck at Deurali (3,230m).

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: This is the cheese heritage day of the trek. The route passes toward Thodung, famous for its historic yak/chauri cheese production. The first yak cheese factory associated with the circuit was established in the 1950s; sources commonly cite 1957 for the Thodung facility.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: A long descent brings you to Those, completing the main Numbur Cheese Circuit. Those is traditionally used as the end point of the circuit.

NCC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC-R001.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

Travel from Kathmandu to Bandipur (TANAHU) Depart from Kathmandu by tourist bus or private vehicle towards Bandipur, a picturesque Newari hill town. The journey offers scenic views and takes approximately 3-4 hours. Arrive in Bandipur, check into your heritage hotel and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, savoring the peaceful ambiance.

ABC-R007.stage_title: Trek from Tikhedhunga . Early hike to Poon Hill
ABC-R007.terrain: POKHARA TO NAYAPUL 🚍 Bus: 500 Per Person 📌 Baglung Bus Park ,Pokhara. 🚙 Jeep: 800 Per Person 📌 HariChowk, Pokhara. 📞 9856010928
ABC-R007.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.
Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul After an early breakfast, take a private vehicle or local bus from Pokhara to Nayapul, the starting point of the trek. The scenic drive takes approximately 1.5-2 hours.
Trek stage to GHANDRUK (1940 m). Gurung village. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Descend to Kimrong Khola and ascend stone pathways to Chhomrong (2,170m), the dramatic terraced Gurung village directly facing Fishtail and Annapurna South.
Drop through bamboo thickets into the narrow Modi Khola gorge, ascending steadily past weeping waterfalls to reach Himalaya Hotel (2,920m).

Early morning hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) for sunrise over the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna ranges, followed by a ridgeline descent through deep forest to Tadapani (2,630m).

AC-R003.description: Trek stage to Nar Village (4110 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

AC-R003.terrain: This is the key acclimatization day before the 5,300+ m Kang La Pass
AC-R003.description: Trek stage to Nar Village (4110 m). This is the key acclimatization day before the 5,300+ m Kang La Pass. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC-R003.stage_title: Nar → Jhombu Kharka → Kang La Pass → Kang La Phedi → Ngawal
AC-R003.terrain: Start before dawn Gradual climb across yak pastures Final steep switchbacks to the pass
AC-R003.description: The hardest day of the Nar Phu section. A long descent on scree and alpine trails eventually joins the main Annapurna Circuit at Ngawal.

AC-R003.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R003.description: Trek stage to Manang (3540 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

AC-R003.terrain: Hydrate aggressively Eat well Sleep early Most trekkers start at 3:00–4:00 AM the next day

TRL_IT001.terrain: Explore city and visit Bhimsen mandir dolkha
TRL_IT001.description: Drive along the Araniko and BP highways to Charikot (1,955m), the scenic district capital of Dolakha, enjoying panoramic vistas of Gauri Shankar.

TRL_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
TRL_IT001.description: Winding descent down the mountain highway along the Tamakoshi River to Singati Bazaar (950m), a bustling local trading center.

TRL_IT001.terrain: On the way, you will come across beautiful landscapes and waterfalls which will welcome you on the way.
TRL_IT001.description: Jeep drive along the rugged river road to Chetchet (1,398m), crossing the long suspension bridge that marks the official trailhead for Rolwaling.

TRL_IT001.terrain: Once at Chetchet, start your trek to Simi Gaun. Cross a beautiful suspension bridge and climb steep stairs and a well-maintained trail. According to the season, you will see crops on the farmlands. Distance from Chectchet to Simi Gaun is just 2.5 KM which you can cover around 2-3 hours.
TRL_IT001.description: Steep stone staircase ascent of over 600 vertical meters through terraced fields to Simigaun (2,000m), a picturesque Buddhist and Hindu village perched high on the ridge.
Trek stage to Surmuche (2470 m). Beautiful views. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Trek stage to Kyalche (2810 m). Sunrise view. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

TRL_IT001.terrain: Dongang is a beautiful place beside a gurgling Rolwaling river and a peaceful lush green forest. It is a popular stop for travelers, trekkers, and porters as this place provides an amazing vibe and a great place to rest.
TRL_IT001.description: Trek stage to Dongang (2800 m). Dongang is a beautiful place beside a gurgling Rolwaling river and a peaceful lush green forest. It is a popular stop for travelers, trekkers, and porters as this place provides an amazing vibe and a great place to rest.. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Trek stage to Thanding (3343 m). Gurung village. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

TRL_IT001.terrain: The trail is full of mind-blowing landscapes, peaceful trails, a few challenging stairs, and mesmerizing waterfalls. On the way, you will cross a few bridges over a powerful river marking its territory. Landscape slowly changes with fewer trees and more open pasture land with giant hills surrounding. Cross a huge suspension bridge right before entering the Beding area, which is a unique experience to get.
TRL_IT001.description: Climb through dense forests into the glacial Rolwaling valley, passing Kyalche and Dongang to arrive at Beding (3,690m), the historic cultural hub of the valley.

TRL_IT001.terrain: Na Village is one of the most beautiful village as the landscape is very unique with well-maintained trails and traditional houses along the beautiful pastureland. The path leading to the village is very peaceful. Along the way, you will be accompanied by small waterfalls and seasonal vegetation that includes vibrant flowers. Once you reach the settlement you will also get to see domesticated animals such as yaks and highland cattle grazing from a distance.
TRL_IT001.description: Gentle acclimatization walk past Mani walls and alpine yak pastures, arriving at Na Village (4,180m), the highest permanent summer settlement in Rolwaling.

TRL_IT001.terrain: Tsho Rolpa Lake, one of the most beautiful lakes enclosed by giant mountains and mesmerizing views. Visit Dudh Kunda, which is around 4 km far from Tsho Rolpa Lake. The trek to Dudh Kunda is optional which is a small lake above Tsho Rolpa Lake. Soak in the beauty of the lakes and explore the surroundings.
TRL_IT001.description: Hike along the glacial moraine to Tsho-Rolpa Glacial Lake (4,580m), Nepal's largest turquoise glacial lake, framed by sheer ice walls and towering peaks.

Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

EBC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
EBC-R001.description: Today's trek of 7.9 km feels more like a hop and a skip as we tackle the largely downhill hike from Khumjung to Monjo (2,835 m), also spelled Manjo, our lungs nearing bursting point with what now feels like excessively oxygenated air! The ever-greener scenery is incredibly pretty, and we spend much of the day walking along forest paths, crossing a handful of suspension bridges, and enjoying the background soundtrack of the Dudh Kosi.

Travel from Kathmandu to Bandipur (TANAHU) Depart from Kathmandu by tourist bus or private vehicle towards Bandipur, a picturesque Newari hill town. The journey offers scenic views and takes approximately 3-4 hours. Arrive in Bandipur, check into your heritage hotel and enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, savoring the peaceful ambiance.

ABC_R007.stage_title: Trek from Tikhedhunga . Early hike to Poon Hill
ABC_R007.terrain: POKHARA TO NAYAPUL 🚍 Bus: 500 Per Person 📌 Baglung Bus Park ,Pokhara. 🚙 Jeep: 800 Per Person 📌 HariChowk, Pokhara. 📞 9856010928
ABC_R007.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.
Drive from Pokhara to Nayapul After an early breakfast, take a private vehicle or local bus from Pokhara to Nayapul, the starting point of the trek. The scenic drive takes approximately 1.5-2 hours.
Trek stage to GHANDRUK (1940 m). Gurung village. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Descend to Kimrong Khola and ascend stone pathways to Chhomrong (2,170m), the dramatic terraced Gurung village directly facing Fishtail and Annapurna South.
Drop through bamboo thickets into the narrow Modi Khola gorge, ascending steadily past weeping waterfalls to reach Himalaya Hotel (2,920m).

ABC_R007.description: Climb past Hinku Cave along steep rock walls where avalanches often run, keeping a steady pace to reach the narrow valley bottleneck at Deurali (3,230m).
Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.
Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.
Trail climbs to Chhomrong then drops down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m), famous for natural hot spring pools beside the roaring Modi Khola.
Celebrate dawn over the Annapurna amphitheater, then descend rapidly down the Modi Khola valley through Deurali and Dovan to rest at Bamboo (2,310m).
Trek stage to Nayapul (1070 m). Back to Pokhara. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.
Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

Travel along the Prithvi Highway to Pokhara (822m) or take a 25-minute scenic flight. Relax by Phewa Lake with views of Fishtail (Machhapuchhre) and prep for the trailhead.

NABC-IT001.stage_title: Pokhara to Tatopani (1,190m) – 6-7 Hours by Local Jeep or Bus
NABC-IT001.description: Travel on a local bus or jeep to Tatopani, known for its natural hot springs. The ride takes you through winding mountain roads, offering glimpses of rural life and cascading waterfalls. Buckle up for a thrilling off-road journey to Hum Khola, a small village surrounded by towering hills and flowing rivers.

NABC-IT001.stage_title: Today’s hike is shorter but incredibly rewarding. As you approach Panchakunda, the landscapes transform into rocky outcrops and meadows dotted with wildflowers. The air feels crisp, and the towering peaks seem closer than ever. Locals believe Panchakunda is a sacred site, adding a spiritual touch to the journey. A relatively short hike takes you to the Annapurna North Base Camp, where you’ll be greeted by the awe-inspiring sight of Annapurna I (8,091m) and its neighboring peaks. The base camp feels like another world, with its glaciers, rocky terrain, and serene atmosphere. Spend time soaking in the views and capturing unforgettable moments. Overnight in a tented camp.
NABC-IT001.description: The trail to Sadi Kharka takes you through dense rhododendrons and oak forests, with occasional clearings that offer stunning views of the Annapurna range. The climb is gradual, allowing you to acclimatize. The trail to Bhusket Mela becomes steeper as you climb higher into the alpine terrain.

NABC-IT001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC-IT001.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.

NABC-IT001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC-IT001.description: Trek stage to Bhusket Mela (3850 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NABC-IT001.stage_title: The bumpy ride back to Tatopani feels like a reunion with modern comforts. You’ll enjoy the hot springs once again, easing your tired muscles and letting the warmth sink in after days of trekking. Spend the evening relaxing and enjoying the cozy atmosphere of this small village.
NABC-IT001.description: Afterward, continue trekking down to Siwai, where a private vehicle awaits to drive you back to Pokhara. This marks the end of your memorable Annapurna Base Camp trek.

NABC-IT001.stage_title: Heading back to Pokhara, you’ll feel a mix of emotions—relief, accomplishment, and nostalgia. The drive offers a final chance to soak in the beauty of the hills before you arrive in Pokhara. Once back, treat yourself to a delicious meal and perhaps a stroll by the Phewa Lake.
NABC-IT001.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.
