NABC_IT001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.
Travel along the Prithvi Highway to Pokhara (822m) or take a 25-minute scenic flight. Relax by Phewa Lake with views of Fishtail (Machhapuchhre) and prep for the trailhead.

NABC_IT001.stage_title: Pokhara to Tatopani (1,190m) – 6-7 Hours by Local Jeep or Bus
NABC_IT001.description: Travel on a local bus or jeep to Tatopani, known for its natural hot springs. The ride takes you through winding mountain roads, offering glimpses of rural life and cascading waterfalls. Buckle up for a thrilling off-road journey to Hum Khola, a small village surrounded by towering hills and flowing rivers.

NABC_IT001.stage_title: Today’s hike is shorter but incredibly rewarding. As you approach Panchakunda, the landscapes transform into rocky outcrops and meadows dotted with wildflowers. The air feels crisp, and the towering peaks seem closer than ever. Locals believe Panchakunda is a sacred site, adding a spiritual touch to the journey. A relatively short hike takes you to the Annapurna North Base Camp, where you’ll be greeted by the awe-inspiring sight of Annapurna I (8,091m) and its neighboring peaks. The base camp feels like another world, with its glaciers, rocky terrain, and serene atmosphere. Spend time soaking in the views and capturing unforgettable moments. Overnight in a tented camp.
NABC_IT001.description: The trail to Sadi Kharka takes you through dense rhododendrons and oak forests, with occasional clearings that offer stunning views of the Annapurna range. The climb is gradual, allowing you to acclimatize. The trail to Bhusket Mela becomes steeper as you climb higher into the alpine terrain.

NABC_IT001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC_IT001.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.

NABC_IT001.stage_title: After a peaceful morning at the base camp, you’ll retrace your steps to Bhusket Mela. The descent feels easier, and you’ll have more time to enjoy the views and reflect on your achievement.
NABC_IT001.description: Trek stage to Bhusket Mela (3850 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NABC_IT001.stage_title: The bumpy ride back to Tatopani feels like a reunion with modern comforts. You’ll enjoy the hot springs once again, easing your tired muscles and letting the warmth sink in after days of trekking. Spend the evening relaxing and enjoying the cozy atmosphere of this small village.
NABC_IT001.description: Afterward, continue trekking down to Siwai, where a private vehicle awaits to drive you back to Pokhara. This marks the end of your memorable Annapurna Base Camp trek.

NABC_IT001.stage_title: Heading back to Pokhara, you’ll feel a mix of emotions—relief, accomplishment, and nostalgia. The drive offers a final chance to soak in the beauty of the hills before you arrive in Pokhara. Once back, treat yourself to a delicious meal and perhaps a stroll by the Phewa Lake.
NABC_IT001.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.

EBC_IT001.stage_title: Fly from KTM to Lukla and trek to Phakding, enjoying breathtaking mountain views
EBC_IT001.terrain: Embark on your trek to Phakding, traversing the scenic route through Nurning Ghat (2,590 m).
EBC_IT001.description: Arrive at Lukla airstrip and begin trekking north along the Dudh Koshi river past carved Mani stones to Phakding (2,610m).

EBC_IT001.stage_title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar as the gateway to the Everest region
EBC_IT001.description: Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

hotels.name: Hotel Everest View
hotels.package: Social gathering spot with scenic surroundings

EBC_IT001.terrain: Tengboche Monastery, the spiritual heart of the Khumbu region, explore the monastery, soak in the peaceful surroundings and admire the intricate architecture and spiritual significance of this sacred place. As one of the most important monasteries in the region,.
EBC_IT001.description: Follow the panoramic Dudh Koshi contour trail before a winding climb through rhododendron woods to Tengboche Monastery (3,867m), framed by Ama Dablam and Everest.

EBC_IT001.stage_title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche amidst breathtaking mountain scenery
EBC_IT001.terrain: Dingboche known as the "summer valley," is a popular stop for trekkers heading to Everest Base Camp due to its stunning location and ample facilities. Vast open fields with majestic backdrop of Ama Dablam.
EBC_IT001.description: Trek above the treeline past Pangboche and the Imja Valley into the stone-walled alpine village of Dingboche (4,410m), key for high-altitude acclimatization.

hotels.name: Everest Resort Dingboche
hotels.package: Simple hotel close to religious sites

EBC_IT001.stage_title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche with Spectacular Mountain Views
EBC_IT001.terrain: Lobuche a small settlement nestled in the shadows of some of the world’s highest mountains, including Pumori and Nuptse. The crisp air combined with awe-inspiring vistas of these towering peaks.
EBC_IT001.description: Ascend the terminal moraine of the Khumbu Glacier, pausing at the poignant Chukpo Lari climber memorials before reaching the high outpost of Lobuche (4,940m).

hotels.name: New EBC Guest House
hotels.package: Budget-friendly with Wi-Fi near pilgrimage site

EBC_IT001.stage_title: Trek from Lobuche to Everest Base Camp and stay overnight in Gorak Shep
EBC_IT001.terrain: Take time to immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere and capture stunning photographs of this unforgettable experience. The sight of vibrant tents set against the stunning backdrop of Mount Everest will create lasting memories you'll cherish for a lifetime. Celebrate this remarkable achievement with your fellow trekkers, sharing stories and laughter that will bond you for life.
EBC_IT001.description: Trek across the boulder-strewn lateral moraine of the Khumbu Glacier to Gorak Shep (5,164m) and push forward to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) right at the base of the Khumbu Icefall.

EBC_IT001.stage_title: Sunrise at Kala Patthar and Trekking Adventure to Pheriche
EBC_IT001.terrain: Stunning display of colors as the sun rises over the towering peaks, including the magnificent Mount Everest. Breathtaking photographs and personal reflection amid the natural beauty of the world's highest mountains.
EBC_IT001.description: Pre-dawn climb of Kala Patthar (5,545m) for the premier golden sunrise over Mount Everest, followed by a steady descent down the windy valley to Pheriche (4,371m).
Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

hotels.name: Hotel Everest View
hotels.package: Social gathering spot with scenic surroundings

EBC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
EBC_IT001.description: Today's trek of 7.9 km feels more like a hop and a skip as we tackle the largely downhill hike from Khumjung to Monjo (2,835 m), also spelled Manjo, our lungs nearing bursting point with what now feels like excessively oxygenated air! The ever-greener scenery is incredibly pretty, and we spend much of the day walking along forest paths, crossing a handful of suspension bridges, and enjoying the background soundtrack of the Dudh Kosi.

EBC_IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
EBC_IT001.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

NCC_R002.stage_title: Explore Kathmandu and prepare for trek.
NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: Drive from Kathmandu through Dolakha/Ramechhap toward Jiri and Shivalaya. Shivalaya is the traditional gateway to the Numbur Cheese Circuit and also lies on the historic Jiri approach toward Everest.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: The trail gradually climbs through cultivated terraces and forest. You pass small settlements before reaching Khahare.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: The route becomes increasingly alpine as it climbs toward Panipakha. Forest gradually changes as elevation increases. Panipakha is an important camping location on the circuit.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: The trail climbs through rhododendron and alpine vegetation toward the summer pasture of Maanedanda. This is an important acclimatization stage because the elevation approaches 4,000 m.

This is one of the most scenic days of the trek. The route climbs from Maanedanda toward Jatapokhari and then continues to Panch Pokhari, a sacred high-altitude lake group. Panch Pokhari is reported at approximately 4,515 m, although some sources give slightly different elevations for the lake area.
Trek stage to Tare/Thare Kharka (4880 m). Accommodation: Camping. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

NCC_R002.stage_title: Tare Kharka → Gyajo La → Dudhpokhari/Likhu area
NCC_R002.terrain: Overnight: Depending on the exact route, camp near Dudhpokhari/Likhu area or continue toward Ngeju.
NCC_R002.description: This is the most demanding section of the circuit. You climb from Tare toward Gyajo La, also referred to as Thulo Lapcha in some descriptions. At approximately 4,880 m / 16,010 ft, it is the highest point of the standard circuit.
Continue through the remote Likhu basin. The trail descends from the high glacial environment toward Ngeju Kharka.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: The trail now descends significantly toward the lower settlements. Lhachhewar is situated in a more vegetated environment compared with the barren high-altitude landscape.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: Trek stage to Gumdel (3360 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: Climb past Hinku Cave along steep rock walls where avalanches often run, keeping a steady pace to reach the narrow valley bottleneck at Deurali (3,230m).

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: This is the cheese heritage day of the trek. The route passes toward Thodung, famous for its historic yak/chauri cheese production. The first yak cheese factory associated with the circuit was established in the 1950s; sources commonly cite 1957 for the Thodung facility.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: A long descent brings you to Those, completing the main Numbur Cheese Circuit. Those is traditionally used as the end point of the circuit.

NCC_R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
NCC_R002.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

AC-R001.stage_title: Thrill Ride Through Kathmandu - Test Ride Adventure
AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

AC-R001.stage_title: Drive from Kathmandu to Besisahar Cycling from Besisahar to Tal
AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Hike along the dramatic Marshyangdi gorge to Tal (1,700m), an enchanting village set beside a flat sandy riverbed and a thundering waterfall.

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Continue your adventure with a scenic ride toward Chame (2,670m), the gateway to the higher Himalayas. Pedal through lush forests and along cascading waterfalls, with towering peaks rising dramatically around you. Each turn of the trail immerses you deeper into the raw beauty of the Annapurna region.
AC-R001.recommended_lodges: HOTEL WHITE ROCK GUEST HOUSE AND RESTAURANT

hotels.name: HOTEL WHITE ROCK GUEST HOUSE AND RESTAURANT
hotels.package: NPR 1,500 [Include room, Dinner🍽️, Breakfast🥞, Device Charging and Wi-fi]

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Day 6 unfolds with a rewarding challenge as you ascend from Chame to the high-altitude village of Manang (3,351m). The trail gradually opens up, transitioning from dense forests to a dramatic, arid landscape framed by towering peaks like Annapurna II and Gangapurna. As you ride along the widening jeep track, the crisp mountain air and sweeping views inspire every pedal stroke.

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Enjoy a full rest day in the stunning village of Manang. Let your body acclimatize while you explore at an easy pace visit a local monastery, stroll to Gangapurna Lake, or learn about altitude health at the Rescue Association Clinic. In the evening, relax and soak in the majestic Himalayan views from your cozy guesthouse.

AC-R001.stage_title: Cycling from Manang to Thorong Phedi
AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Ascend the desolate lunar landscape above the treeline to Thorong Phedi (4,540m), the crucial high-altitude staging point before crossing the legendary Thorong La Pass.

AC-R001.stage_title: Cycling from Thorong Phedi to Muktinath
AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Start early around 5:00 a.m. for the ultimate challenge the ascent to Thorong La Pass (5,416m), the world s highest navigable mountain pass. This demanding climb pushes both body and spirit as you carry and push your bike through thin air, icy winds, and steep slopes.

hotels.name: Hotel Grand Shambala
hotels.package: Budget-friendly with Wi-Fi near pilgrimage site

hotels.name: Hotel De Purang
hotels.package: Simple hotel close to religious sites

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Descend from the sacred shrines of Muktinath through the windy Kali Gandaki gorge to Marpha (2,670m), the historic stone-paved Thakali apple capital.

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Enjoy a mostly downhill ride through pine forests and quaint villages, following the river as snow-capped peaks tower around you. The gentle descent offers a relaxing pace, perfect for soaking in the serene beauty of the valley and reflecting on your adventure so far. Arrive in Tatopani, famous for its natural hot springs, and rejuvenate your body in the warm, soothing waters after a rewarding day on the bike.

AC-R001.stage_title: Cycling from Tatopani to Beni and Drive to Pokhara
AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Complete the final trail stage and board vehicle transfer back to Pokhara (822m). Free evening to relax at Lakeside cafes and celebrate trail completion.

AC-R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-R001.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

LVT-R007.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.
Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.
Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).
Climb gradually through widening river gorges past Ghodatabela checkpost (3,030m). Reach the resilient alpine settlement of Langtang Village (3,430m) beneath Langtang Lirung.
Short scenic ascent across yak pastures and Mani stone walls to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m). Explore the ancient monastery, local yak cheese factory, and majestic 360-degree amphitheater.

LVT-R007.stage_title: Yala Kharka Base Camp to Yala Peak to Kyanjin Gompa
LVT-R007.description: Trek along the lateral moraine of the Barun Glacier to Makalu Base Camp (4,870m), surrounded by the immense south face of Makalu and Everest's Kangshung face.
Short scenic ascent across yak pastures and Mani stone walls to Kyanjin Gompa (3,870m). Explore the ancient monastery, local yak cheese factory, and majestic 360-degree amphitheater.
Ascend along the Langtang Khola through dense oak, bamboo, and rhododendron forests, crossing suspension bridges to reach the peaceful forest settlement of Lama Hotel (2,470m).
Scenic mountain drive along the Trishuli River highway to Syabrubesi (1,460m), the bustling gateway to Langtang Valley and Tamang Heritage Trail.
Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Kathmandu → Dhading Besi → Arughat → Soti Khola → Machha Khola
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Follow the Budhi Gandaki gorge across suspension bridges and rocky riverbeds, passing waterfalls and terraced hillsides to reach the Gurung village of Machha Khola (900m).

MBC-R002.stage_title: Machha Khola →Khorlabesi → Tatopani → Dovan → Thado Bharyang → Yaru Khola→Jagat
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Ascend alongside the roaring river gorge, crossing cantilever bridges and Tatopani natural hot springs to enter the stone-paved conservation checkpoint village of Jagat (1,340m).

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Trek stage to Chumling (2386 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Trek stage to Chhokang Paro (3010 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Chhokang Paro → Lamagaon → Milarepa Cave area → Phurbe → Pangdun → Chhule → Nile
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Trek stage to Nile (3361 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Nile →Dephyudonma → Mu Gompa (3,700 m) → return Nile
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Trek stage to Nile (3361 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Nile → Chhule →Pangdun → Rachen Gompa → Chhokang Paro → Gho → Domje → Chumling
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: This is mostly downhill, allowing recovery before rejoining the main circuit. Important Buddhist nunnery, long descent through the heart of Tsum Valley.

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Trek through bamboo groves and cross the suspension bridge into Deng (1,860m), the cultural entrance to the Tibetan-influenced Nubri region.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Deng → Rana → Bihi Phedi → Ghap → Prok side trail junction → Namrung gate → Namrung
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Ascend steeply through lush rhododendron and fir forests, climbing into the upper alpine valley to reach Namrung (2,630m), known for its scenic apple orchards and stone gates.

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Hike through pine woodlands and chortens to the terraced village of Lho (3,180m), famous for Ribum Gompa and panoramic direct views of Mount Manaslu's twin peaks.

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Pass Mani walls and alpine pastures to enter Samagaon (3,530m), the largest Buddhist settlement in the Nubri valley beneath Mount Manaslu, with acclimatization trails to Birendra Tal.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Samagaun → Birendra Lake → Pungyen Gompa → Base Camp viewpoint → Samagaun
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Pass Mani walls and alpine pastures to enter Samagaon (3,530m), the largest Buddhist settlement in the Nubri valley beneath Mount Manaslu, with acclimatization trails to Birendra Tal.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Samagaun → Kermo Kharka → White Kani → Budhi Gandaki headwaters → Samdo
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Gradual scenic trek along the upper Budhi Gandaki yak pastures, approaching the historic Tibetan trading border settlement of Samdo (3,860m).

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Climb past the abandoned market of Larkya Bazaar to Dharamsala / Larkya Phedi (4,460m), the rugged high camp refuge preparing for the Larkya La pass.

MBC-R002.stage_title: Cross Larkya La Pass [5,106 m]→ Bimthang
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Pre-dawn crossing of Larkya La Pass (5,160m) with sweeping views of Himlung Himal and Cheo Himal, followed by a dramatic descent into the stunning glacial meadow of Bimthang (3,720m).

MBC-R002.stage_title: Bimthang → Ponkar →Karche → Gho → Tilije bridge → Tilije→ Thonje →Dharapani
MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Descend through pine and rhododendron forests past Tilije to Dharapani (1,860m), where the Manaslu trail joins the Annapurna Circuit.

MBC-R002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
MBC-R002.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

AC-IT002.description: Branch away from the main circuit trail and follow scenic mountain contours into Shree Kharka (4,070m) on the approach to Tilicho Lake.

AC-IT002.terrain: Forest trail
AC-IT002.description: Acclimatization stage climbing past ancient juniper groves and yak pastures to Yak Kharka (4,050m), resting beneath towering rock faces.

AC-IT002.terrain: Narrow gorges Wooden bridges Dense forest Steep ascents to Meta

AC-IT002.stage_title: Tilicho Base Camp to Shree Kharka (via Tilicho Lake)
AC-IT002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-IT002.description: Trek stage to Nar Village (4110 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

AC-IT002.terrain: This is the key acclimatization day before the 5,300+ m Kang La Pass
AC-IT002.description: Trek stage to Nar Village (4110 m). This is the key acclimatization day before the 5,300+ m Kang La Pass. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC-IT002.stage_title: Nar → Jhombu Kharka → Kang La Pass → Kang La Phedi → Ngawal
AC-IT002.terrain: Start before dawn Gradual climb across yak pastures Final steep switchbacks to the pass
AC-IT002.description: The hardest day of the Nar Phu section. A long descent on scree and alpine trails eventually joins the main Annapurna Circuit at Ngawal.

AC-IT002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-IT002.description: Trek stage to Manang (3540 m). Scenic trail with steady elevation change, alpine vistas, and local hospitality along the marked route.

AC-IT002.terrain: Best Acclimatization Options Hike Altitude Time Gangapurna Lake 3,900 m 2–3 hr Ice Lake 4,600 m 5–6 hr Chongkor Viewpoint 4,200 m 3–4 hr
AC-IT002.description: Trek stage to Manang (3540 m). Best Acclimatization Options Hike Altitude Time Gangapurna Lake 3,900 m 2–3 hr Ice Lake 4,600 m 5–6 hr Chongkor Viewpoint 4,200 m 3–4 hr. Maintain steady pacing and hydrate regularly on this stage.

AC-IT002.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
AC-IT002.description: Acclimatization stage climbing past ancient juniper groves and yak pastures to Yak Kharka (4,050m), resting beneath towering rock faces.

AC-IT002.terrain: Hydrate aggressively Eat well Sleep early Most trekkers start at 3:00–4:00 AM the next day
AC-IT002.description: Ascend the desolate lunar landscape above the treeline to Thorong Phedi (4,540m), the crucial high-altitude staging point before crossing the legendary Thorong La Pass.

AC-IT002.stage_title: Thorong Phedi → High Camp → Thorong La Pass → Chabarbu → Muktinath
AC-IT002.terrain: 900 m ascent in cold pre-dawn conditions Slow, steady pace is essential
AC-IT002.description: The classic Annapurna Circuit high-pass day. A long 1,600 m descent leads to the sacred pilgrimage site of Muktinath.

hotels.name: Hotel De Purang
hotels.package: Simple hotel close to religious sites

EBC_R001.terrain: Discover vibrant local markets, indulge in traditional Nepali dishes and delve into Kathmandu's rich cultural tapestry. This initial day is perfect for easing into your journey, setting the stage for the exciting adventures ahead in Khumbu region.
EBC_R001.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

EBC_R001.stage_title: Fly from KTM to Lukla and trek to Phakding, enjoying breathtaking mountain views
EBC_R001.terrain: Embark on your trek to Phakding, traversing the scenic route through Nurning Ghat (2,590 m).
EBC_R001.description: Arrive at Lukla airstrip and begin trekking north along the Dudh Koshi river past carved Mani stones to Phakding (2,610m).

EBC_R001.stage_title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar as the gateway to the Everest region
EBC_R001.description: Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

hotels.name: Hotel Everest View
hotels.package: Social gathering spot with scenic surroundings

EBC_R001.terrain: Tengboche Monastery, the spiritual heart of the Khumbu region, explore the monastery, soak in the peaceful surroundings and admire the intricate architecture and spiritual significance of this sacred place. As one of the most important monasteries in the region,.
EBC_R001.description: Follow the panoramic Dudh Koshi contour trail before a winding climb through rhododendron woods to Tengboche Monastery (3,867m), framed by Ama Dablam and Everest.

EBC_R001.stage_title: Trek from Tengboche to Dingboche amidst breathtaking mountain scenery
EBC_R001.terrain: Dingboche known as the "summer valley," is a popular stop for trekkers heading to Everest Base Camp due to its stunning location and ample facilities. Vast open fields with majestic backdrop of Ama Dablam.
EBC_R001.description: Trek above the treeline past Pangboche and the Imja Valley into the stone-walled alpine village of Dingboche (4,410m), key for high-altitude acclimatization.

hotels.name: Everest Resort Dingboche
hotels.package: Simple hotel close to religious sites

EBC_R001.stage_title: Trek from Dingboche to Lobuche with Spectacular Mountain Views
EBC_R001.terrain: Lobuche a small settlement nestled in the shadows of some of the world’s highest mountains, including Pumori and Nuptse. The crisp air combined with awe-inspiring vistas of these towering peaks.
EBC_R001.description: Ascend the terminal moraine of the Khumbu Glacier, pausing at the poignant Chukpo Lari climber memorials before reaching the high outpost of Lobuche (4,940m).

hotels.name: New EBC Guest House
hotels.package: Budget-friendly with Wi-Fi near pilgrimage site

EBC_R001.stage_title: Trek from Lobuche to Everest Base Camp and stay overnight in Gorak Shep
EBC_R001.terrain: Take time to immerse yourself in the incredible atmosphere and capture stunning photographs of this unforgettable experience. The sight of vibrant tents set against the stunning backdrop of Mount Everest will create lasting memories you'll cherish for a lifetime. Celebrate this remarkable achievement with your fellow trekkers, sharing stories and laughter that will bond you for life.
EBC_R001.description: Trek across the boulder-strewn lateral moraine of the Khumbu Glacier to Gorak Shep (5,164m) and push forward to Everest Base Camp (5,364m) right at the base of the Khumbu Icefall.

EBC_R001.stage_title: Sunrise at Kala Patthar and Trekking Adventure to Pheriche
EBC_R001.terrain: Stunning display of colors as the sun rises over the towering peaks, including the magnificent Mount Everest. Breathtaking photographs and personal reflection amid the natural beauty of the world's highest mountains.
EBC_R001.description: Pre-dawn climb of Kala Patthar (5,545m) for the premier golden sunrise over Mount Everest, followed by a steady descent down the windy valley to Pheriche (4,371m).
Cross the soaring Hillary Suspension Bridge and make the steep ascent through pine forests to Namche Bazaar (3,440m), the vibrant Sherpa capital with bakeries and gear shops.

hotels.name: Hotel Everest View
hotels.package: Social gathering spot with scenic surroundings

EBC_R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
EBC_R001.description: Today's trek of 7.9 km feels more like a hop and a skip as we tackle the largely downhill hike from Khumjung to Monjo (2,835 m), also spelled Manjo, our lungs nearing bursting point with what now feels like excessively oxygenated air! The ever-greener scenery is incredibly pretty, and we spend much of the day walking along forest paths, crossing a handful of suspension bridges, and enjoying the background soundtrack of the Dudh Kosi.

EBC_R001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
EBC_R001.description: Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

ABC-IT005.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport (1,350m) and transfer to Thamel. Prepare gear, check permits, and attend the pre-trek orientation briefing.

ABC-IT005.terrain: POKHARA TO LANDRUK 🚍 Bus: 500 Per Person 📌 Baglung Bus Park ,Pokhara. 🚙 Jeep: 800 Per Person 📌 HariChowk, Pokhara. 📞 9856010928
ABC-IT005.description: Travel along the Prithvi Highway to Pokhara (822m) or take a 25-minute scenic flight. Relax by Phewa Lake with views of Fishtail (Machhapuchhre) and prep for the trailhead.

ABC-IT005.stage_title: Drive to Dhampus and Trek to Landruk
ABC-IT005.description: Trek across the Modi Khola suspension bridge and ascend terraced slopes to Landruk (1,565m), enjoying views of Ghandruk across the valley.
Descend to Kimrong Khola and ascend stone pathways to Chhomrong (2,170m), the dramatic terraced Gurung village directly facing Fishtail and Annapurna South.
Drop through bamboo thickets into the narrow Modi Khola gorge, ascending steadily past weeping waterfalls to reach Himalaya Hotel (2,920m).

hotels.name: Hotel Royal Family And Restaurant
hotels.package: NPR 2,000 [Include room, Dinner, Breakfast, Device charging, Hot shower, Wi-Fi]

ABC-IT005.description: Ascend into the sacred Annapurna Sanctuary via Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700m), reaching Annapurna Base Camp (4,130m) enveloped in a magnificent 360-degree mountain bowl.
Celebrate dawn over the Annapurna amphitheater, then descend rapidly down the Modi Khola valley through Deurali and Dovan to rest at Bamboo (2,310m).
Trail climbs to Chhomrong then drops down to Jhinu Danda (1,780m), famous for natural hot spring pools beside the roaring Modi Khola.
Scenic return drive or flight back to Kathmandu (1,350m). Settle into your hotel in Thamel, enjoy a celebratory farewell dinner, and conclude the expedition.

BA-IT001.description: A long but scenic drive following the Trishuli and Marsyangdi rivers. Drive through Kohalpur. Overnight stay at Dhangadi.

BA-IT001.stage_title: Dharapani → Bagarchhap → Danaque → Timang → Thanchok → Koto
BA-IT001.terrain: Gradual alpine trail with mountain views
BA-IT001.description: Arrive in Martadi (1,580m), the district capital of Bajura and traditional launch point for the sacred Badimalika wilderness pilgrimage.

BA-IT001.stage_title: Koto → Soti Khola → Dharmashala → Chyakhu → Meta
BA-IT001.terrain: Narrow gorges Wooden bridges Dense forest Steep ascents to Meta
BA-IT001.description: Trekking begins. Climb through forest trails. Camp at Sotapatan.

BA-IT001.stage_title: Meta → Junam Goth → Chyakhu Khola → Kyang → Phu Gate → Phu Gaon
BA-IT001.terrain: The valley opens into a high-altitude desert landscape. Ancient chortens, mani walls, and abandoned kharkas appear along the route.
BA-IT001.description: Trek through meadows. Glance the growing views of surrounding ridelines. Camp at Bhittivhinna.

BA-IT001.stage_title: Phu → Tashi Lhakhang Monastery → viewpoint above the village
BA-IT001.terrain: You are now above 4,000 m, so acclimatization significantly reduces the risk of AMS before crossing Kang La.
BA-IT001.description: Trek across rolling green alpine meadows and rolling grasslands to reach the sacred hilltop shrine of Badimalika (4,210m) and the pristine pastures of Tribeni Patan.
